note: Claude's own visual review of all 499 BACK raw-pipeline detections (12 contact-sheet pages), NOT a certified/expert ground truth. Default category is fp_structural (window sill/frame, panel joint/seam, building corner or roof/gutter edge, round vent -- all clearly building-architecture features, not damage). ambiguous = thin vertical/diagonal hairline mark that could be a genuine hairline crack OR a vertical precast-panel control joint -- could not be told apart from a photo crop alone, deliberately NOT labeled either way. background_noise = detection landed off the building entirely (sky/ground/horizon/motion blur). Source input: BACK_cracks.json (V004, 68-image raw-photo pipeline run). This file is the exact input tools/build_hard_negatives_from_review.py consumed to produce the 65 *_hardneg.json files alongside it (the fp_structural 358 crack_ids, by exclusion of ambiguous_ids/background_noise_ids below).
